title: x402 signature conformance vector
description: A self-contained EIP-712 signature conformance vector. Everything needed to reproduce the verdict is in the file, including the domain the x402 specification leaves unstated.

id.description: Stable identifier, zero-padded ordinal plus slug. Never reused.

origin.description: 'spec' = payload and signature taken verbatim from the x402 specifications, expected verdict is the audit result. 'generated' = signed with the published test key. The two must never be conflated.

standard.description: The signing standard under test, e.g. 'EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization'.

types.description: EIP-712 type definitions, excluding EIP712Domain (implied by the domain object).

signature.description: 65 bytes: r (32) || s (32) || v (1), hex with 0x prefix.

verdict.description: The verdict a conformant verifier MUST reach on the signature layer alone.

recovered_address.description: Address the signature actually recovers to, or null when recovery is undefined (malformed signature, or rejected by a form check before recovery).

type_hash.description: keccak256(encodeType(primaryType)) — lets the encoding layer be tested in isolation from ECDSA.

signing_digest.description: keccak256(0x1901 || domainSeparator || hashStruct): the bytes actually signed.

notes.description: Why the vector exists and what a failure on it means. A vector without a stated purpose is noise.

signer.description: Address the message attributes as its signer. Declared, never inferred from field names: a struct may call it anything.
